financing_mechanism: Barter (refined bauxite for infrastructure, no cash exchanged)
scope_summary: Roads, rural electrification, hospitals across all 16 regions; first tranche ~USD646-649m financed 442km of roads (100km Kumasi, 84km Accra plus other links)
outcome_summary: Construction began within ~18 months of deal signing; later criticized by opposition MP Kwame Agbodza (the same Minority figure now scrutinizing Big Push) as 'a fiasco' warranting termination; environmental criticism over bauxite mining in forest reserve areas. Long-run completion status not established in this research pass.
